3510-3875-4875-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Conspiracy.
3510-3875-4875-6705.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Conspiracy and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Provisioner to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Quina.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

2226-2499-3977.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2499-3977.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Yarok.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Horned Kavu by paying its mana cost.
When Horned Kavu enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

728-1492-2866-4986.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
728-1492-2866-4986.description:
Cast Welding Jar by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Welding Jar by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

4247-5671-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

2869-3184-5686--173.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature that costs {0}.
Yomiji triggers, returning that creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1308-4094-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 2, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat from step 2

997-3054-5346-6809.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Crime Novelist and Scion of Opulence trigger.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Scion of Opulence trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

710-5231-7424.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

5470-6188-7297.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
5470-6188-7297.description:
Create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Fear of Missing Out token.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Move to your combat phase and declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, untapping Ghired and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

2457-4289-4365-7297.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2054-2440-4183-7220.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Glamermite
2054-2440-4183-7220.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Glamermite with haste.
When the token Glamermite enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Glamermite trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Glamermite, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Glamermite for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Urn of Godfire twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

1510-4574-5315-5849.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Arcbound Stinger.
When Arcbound Stinger dies, its modular ability triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Arcbound Stinger from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Arcbound Stinger from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

57-4846-4927-6657.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4846-4927-6657.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-2034-3490-3641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-2034-3490-3641.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

3490-4659-6720-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4659-6720-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

586-5258-5618-6798-6967.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2866-4211-4986-5686.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3542-3647-4477.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
3542-3647-4477.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa and Palinchron
When Greenwarden of Murasa and Palinchron enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
3542-3647-4477.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Palinchron.

2577-5670-5789.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-5670-5789.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2047-2104-2707-6504.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation each turn.
2047-2104-2707-6504.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of Conjurer's Bauble.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate the Conjurer's Bauble token by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Temporal Manipulation onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Temporal Manipulation from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each turn.

64-2792-6485.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
64-2792-6485.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Warden of the Eye and Great Whale, targeting Warden of the Eye
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Great Whale.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Great Whale.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Warden of the Eye.
When the Warden of the Eye token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Warden of the Eye and Great Whale tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

800-4116-6478.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Arbor Adherent.
Activate Volrath by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Knacksaw Clique.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}{U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of an opponent's library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Repeat.

1170-5034-5131-5315.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5034-5131-5315.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sol Ring.
Cast Sol Ring from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

2034-3305-4022-4772-5926.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Body Launderer, adding {C}{C}.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating two token copies of each creature card in your graveyard that are 1/1 Insects.
Put all but one of the Grist, Voracious Larva tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva and Hidden Herbalist tokens enter the battlefield, each Hidden Herbalist token triggers once and each Grist, Voracious Larva token triggers for each token created this way.
Resolve all Grist, Voracious Larva triggers, choosing not to pay.
Resolve both Hidden Herbalist triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

877-1374-3223-5910.description:
Cast Nameless Inversion from your graveyard, as it is a Knight card, by paying {0} due to The Ur-Dragon and Morophon, giving a creature +3/-3 until end of turn.
If the creature has toughness 0 or less, the creature dies as a state-based action.
Repeat as desired.

1525-2031-2406-2660-4753.notablePrerequisites:
Clever Impersonator is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1525-2031-2406-2660-4753.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-2031-2406-2660-4753.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

276-791-3693-4522.notablePrerequisites:
Quest for Pure Flame has at least four quest counters on it.
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
276-791-3693-4522.description:
Activate Quest for Pure Flame by removing four quest counters from it and sacrificing it, doubling all damage dealt by sources you control this turn.
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 3.

586-3967-5011-5406.notablePrerequisites: Cavalier of Night exiled by Dinosaur Headdress.
586-3967-5011-5406.description:
Activate Dinosaur Headdress' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Priest of Gix and causing Priest of Gix to become a copy of Cavalier of Night.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, causing it to gain indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

1283-1491-1719-4417.notablePrerequisites:
Sinking Feeling attached to Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Vizier of Tumbling Sands does not have summoning sickness.
1283-1491-1719-4417.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {2}, removing the -1/-1 counter from Vizier of Tumbling Sands and giving Hex Parasite +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

1692-1953-2743.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Biovisionary.
You control at least one additional token.
1692-1953-2743.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host and Brudiclad trigger.
Resolve the Helm of the Host trigger, creating a token copy of Biovisionary with haste.
Resolve the Brudiclad trigger, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr creature token, then choosing to have all tokens you control become copies of the Biovisionary token.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

914-997-2815-5220.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Treasure.
Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-997-2815-5220.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
Dockside Extortionist dies, triggering Mortuary, causing you to put Dockside Extortionist on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Professional Face-Breaker by sacrificing a Treasure, exiling Dockside Extortionist from the top of your library and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Cast Dockside Extortionist from exile by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

719-1339-4219.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
"Sliver" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1339-4219.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield with all creature types due to Maskwood Nexus, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1247-1323-3990-4893.notablePrerequisites: Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
1247-1323-3990-4893.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pili-Pala.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {1} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Incubation Druid.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {1} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pili-Pala.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {1} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Incubation Druid's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Repeat from step 6.

225-2605-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
225-2605-3525.description:
Activate Lotus Vale by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Lotus Vale.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.

618-1053-1099-1799-2240-3189-3873.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
618-1053-1099-1799-2240-3189-3873.description:
Cast Doomsday by paying {B}{B}{B}, searching your library and graveyard for Torch Courier, Kiki-Jiki, Sling-Gang Lieutenant, Brazen Buccaneers and Conspicuous Snoop, exiling all other cards from your graveyard and library, and then placing the remaining cards on top of your library in the order previously listed and losing half your life, rounded up.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Conspicuous Snoop into your graveyard and then onto the battlefield.
Cast Torch Courier from the top of your library by paying {R}.
Activate Torch Courier by sacrificing it, giving Conspicuous Snoop haste until end of turn.
Activate Conspicuous Snoop using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of Conspicuous Snoop with haste.
Repeat step 5 with the new Conspicuous Snoop token an arbitrarily large amount of times.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Brazen Buccaneers into your graveyard and then onto the battlefield.
Brazen Buccaneers enters the battlefield, revealing Kiki-Jiki, putting a +1/+1 counter on Brazen Buccaneers and putting Kiki-Jiki into your graveyard.
Activate a Conspicuous Snoop using Sling-Gang Lieutenant's ability by sacrificing a Goblin, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 9.
